calls.statement:
SELECT s.format,
       COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts,
       SUM(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id), 4) AS atv
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 4
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, s.format, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30'
)
SELECT
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE store_id>=900) AS lines_900plus,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE store_id=999) AS lines_999,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE category='ZZ Test' AND store_id<900) AS test_in_stores,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag AND store_id<900) AS staff_lines,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE net_amount<=0) AS nonpos_net,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE quantity<=0) AS nonpos_qty,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) <> sale_date) AS date_mismatch,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel_code='WB' AND store_id<900) AS wb_in_stores,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'ST' AND store_id<900) AS nonST_in_stores,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id FROM l WHERE store_id<900 GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT store_key)>1 OR count(DISTINCT sale_date)>1 OR count(DISTINCT staff_purchase_flag)>1)) AS odd_receipts
FROM l

calls.statement:
WITH fact AS (
  SELECT cs.store_id, f.sale_date AS business_date, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_before
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id=s.store_id AND cs.is_current
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY 1,2
), r AS (
  SELECT store_id, business_date, receipts, net_sales_before_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales
  WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-03' AND DATE '2026-08-30' AND store_id<900
)
SELECT count(*) AS n_pairs, sum(f.receipts) AS fact_receipts, sum(r.receipts) AS rpt_receipts,
       sum(f.gross_before) AS fact_net, sum(r.net_sales_before_returns) AS rpt_net,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.receipts<>r.receipts OR abs(f.gross_before-r.net_sales_before_returns)>0.01) AS mismatching_days,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM r) AS rpt_rows, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact) AS fact_rows
FROM fact f FULL JOIN r USING (store_id, business_date)
